context: A teen tells his teacher about joining an exchange training camp abroad
purpose: Teach: オリンピック/キャンプ/プレイヤー/ブロック/シュート/ゲスト/大勢/進ま

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 先生、聞いてください、来月の合宿キャンプに呼ばれたんです。
lines.en: Sensei, listen to this, I've been invited to next month's training camp.
lines.style: Excited teen eagerly sharing big news with mentor

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: えっ、もしかしてオリンピック候補のやつ？陸くんがゲストで呼ばれたの？
lines.en: Wait, you mean the Olympic candidates one? You got invited as a guest?
lines.style: Surprised teacher reacting with genuine warmth and curiosity

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: はい、海外の主力プレイヤーたちと一緒に練習できるみたいで、すごく緊張してます。
lines.en: Yes, I'll get to train with top overseas players, and I'm really nervous.
lines.style: Humble teen admitting nerves while showing quiet pride

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 素晴らしいじゃない。大勢の代表クラスの中で揉まれるのは、絶対に力になるよ。
lines.en: That's wonderful. Being pushed among many top-level players will definitely make you stronger.
lines.style: Encouraging teacher offering warm motivational support to student

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: ただ、最近スランプで、相手のブロックを抜く動きが思うようにいかなくて…。
lines.en: But lately I'm slumping; getting past the opponent's block hasn't been going well.
lines.style: Teen confiding self-doubt to a trusted mentor figure

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 焦らなくていいの。基本のスパイクとシュートを地道に続ければ、感覚は必ず戻るから。
lines.en: Don't rush it. Keep grinding basic spikes and shots, and your touch will return.
lines.style: Calm reassuring teacher giving practical and concrete advice

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: それが、調子が戻らないと練習も進まなくて、ちょっと自信なくしてて…。
lines.en: The thing is, until my form returns my practice won't progress, and I've lost some confidence.
lines.style: Teen openly voicing insecurity to caring teacher figure

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 大丈夫、陸くんなら必ず乗り越えられる。土産話、たくさん持って帰ってきてね。
lines.en: It's okay, I know you can get through this. Bring back lots of stories for me.
lines.style: Affectionate teacher sending student off with warmth and confidence

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。帰ったら、必ず報告に来ますね。
lines.en: Thank you. When I get back, I'll definitely come tell you all about it.
lines.style: Grateful teen making a sincere promise to his teacher
